name: Kenya Revenue Authority
notes: Kenya Revenue Authority Act (Cap. 469). PAYE, VAT, withholding taxes; the Commissioner-General is the 'collector' of the Affordable Housing Levy under the Affordable Housing Act, 2024.

name: National Social Security Fund
notes: National Social Security Fund Act, 2013. Employer/employee pension contributions.

name: Social Health Authority
notes: Social Health Insurance Act, 2023. Administers the Social Health Insurance Fund (SHIF); replaced the National Hospital Insurance Fund (NHIF).

name: Affordable Housing Board
notes: Established by s. 16 of the Affordable Housing Act, 2024; manages the Affordable Housing Fund (s. 8). Levy is collected by KRA. Website is the Boma Yangu Affordable Housing Programme portal.

name: National Industrial Training Authority
notes: Industrial Training Act (Cap. 237). Industrial training levy.

name: Higher Education Loans Board
notes: Higher Education Loans Board Act (Cap. 213A). Employer remittance of loan recoveries.

name: Central Bank of Kenya
notes: Central Bank of Kenya Act (Cap. 491). Banks, microfinance banks, payment service providers, forex bureaus, digital credit providers.

name: Capital Markets Authority
notes: Capital Markets Act (Cap. 485A). Site returned HTTP 502/504 at retrieval (2026-11-01); domain is the official one.

name: Sacco Societies Regulatory Authority
notes: Sacco Societies Act, 2008.

name: Insurance Regulatory Authority
notes: Insurance Act (Cap. 487).

name: Retirement Benefits Authority
notes: Retirement Benefits Act (Cap. 197). Site sits behind a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403 to scripts).

name: Communications Authority of Kenya
notes: Kenya Information and Communications Act (Cap. 411A). Numbering plan, telecom licensing.

name: Competition Authority of Kenya
notes: Competition Act, 2010.

name: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
notes: Data Protection Act, 2019. Registration of data controllers/processors. Site returned Cloudflare 525 (origin SSL error) at retrieval.

name: Financial Reporting Centre
notes: Proceeds of Crime and Anti-Money Laundering Act (Cap. 59A). AML/CFT reporting.

name: Business Registration Service
notes: Business Registration Service Act, 2015. Companies, business names, partnerships, beneficial ownership.

name: National Transport and Safety Authority
notes: National Transport and Safety Authority Act, 2012.

name: Kenya Bureau of Standards
notes: Standards Act (Cap. 496). Former domain kebs.org no longer serves the site.

name: Kenya Deposit Insurance Corporation
notes: Kenya Deposit Insurance Act, 2012.

name: Policyholders Compensation Fund
notes: Insurance Act (Cap. 487) s. 179.

name: Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission
notes: Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission Act, 2011.

name: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission
notes: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission Act, 2011.

name: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
notes: Statistics Act, 2006.

name: Kenya National Examinations Council
notes: Kenya National Examinations Council Act, 2012.

name: Kenya National Qualifications Authority
notes: Kenya National Qualifications Framework Act, 2014 (Cap. 214). Site returned HTTP 500 at retrieval.

name: National Employment Authority
notes: National Employment Authority Act, 2016. Registration of private employment agencies; foreign employment.

name: Salaries and Remuneration Commission
notes: Constitution Art. 230. Public sector remuneration.

name: Public Procurement Regulatory Authority
notes: Public Procurement and Asset Disposal Act, 2015.

name: National Council for Persons with Disabilities
notes: Persons with Disabilities Act. Registration of persons with disabilities (relevant to PAYE exemption).

name: Unclaimed Financial Assets Authority
notes: Unclaimed Financial Assets Act, 2011. Site timed out at retrieval.

name: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection
notes: State Department for Labour and Skills Development: labour officers, Labour Relations, Occupational Safety and Health; site title 'Labour and Skills Development'.
